messages:
Anya: Heads-up: who's up for a 'Warehouse Wings + Quirky Quiz' this Friday 6pm? small team-friendly — wings truck + 30-min trivia on the terrace outside HQ. :chicken: :question:
Sam: I'm in. Any veg options? Can't do spicy.
Mira: Count me in. Also will there be seating? I can bring folding chairs.
Diego: I'll run the quiz. 10 rounds, 3 questions each, silly prizes (ceramic chicken trophy).
Chloe: RSVP: react :thumbsup: for in, :eyes: if maybe. Also I can pickup sauces if needed.
KitchenBot: Menu for 'WingTruck Co': buffalo, bbq, lemon-herb, and cauliflower wings (vegan). Add-on: fries, slaw. Order cutoff: Fri 4pm.
Liam: Perfect — can we add a mild option? Non-spicy buffalo?
Anya: Good call. We'll ask vendor for mild buffalo and cauli as veg option. Quick poll: which side do you want? 1) Fries 2) Slaw 3) Both
Chloe: 1
Mira: 3
Sam: 2
Diego: 1
Anya: Cool. So far: Anya, Sam, Mira, Diego, Chloe, Liam. Anyone else? Please react by 3pm Thu.
Chloe: :calendar: I added to the team calendar: https://calendar.example.com/event/warehouse-wings-quiz
Sam: Budget check — how much per person? last time was ~$12.
Anya: Estimate $12-15 pp. We'll do Venmo/CC split at the event. If anyone needs subsidized ticket ping me.
Mira: Can someone bring napkins and wet wipes? Also hand sanitizer station pls.
Diego: I'll bring a first-aid kit and extra pens for quiz sheets. Also printed answer sheets.
Anya: @KitchenBot can you confirm order cutoff again?
KitchenBot: Order cutoff Fri 4pm — confirmed. Place orders via form: https://forms.example.com/wings-order (pls include dietary notes).
Chloe: I'll run the form. Quick sign-up layout I put in the form:
```
Name | Wings choice | Side choice | Notes
```
I'll ping reminders Thu noon.
Liam: Anyone want to carpool? I can leave at 5:30 from lobby.
Sam: I'll take two seats, thanks.
Anya: Awesome. Plan: meet 5:45 by lobby for walk (or 5:30 carpool option). Trivia starts 6:15. Bring curiosity & appetite. :trophy:
KitchenBot: Reminder scheduled: Thu 12:00 — 'Wings + Quiz RSVP reminder'
Diego: Ceramic chicken trophy suggestion: spray painted gold? :grin:
Chloe: :raised_hands: Love it. Also who wants to pick music? I'll make a 90s pump playlist unless someone objects.
Sam: 90s pump yes.
Mira: Love the playlist. See y'all Friday!
